## #310 beatsense phase B: finish the core surface

Branch: overnight/2026-11-12/r1-01-i310-beatsense-core-surface (PR #322)

Decisions
- `RollReader`/`rollLevel` live in `packages/beatsense/src/drums/roll-rate.ts`; the `snareRoll` singleton became `audioAnalysis.snareRoll` (`src/audio.ts`, `AudioAnalysis` type gained `snareRoll`).
- Models: `DRUM_HIT_MODEL`, `RISER_MODEL`, `SWEEP_MODEL`, `RHYTHM_MODEL` exported; `DrumHits(onCandidate?, model)`, `RiserDetector(onSlot?, model)`, `SweepDetector(onSlot?, model)`, `RhythmLabeler(hold, options, model)`, and the pure functions take a trailing model

## #316 beatsense phase H: CPU and bundle budgets plus tests

Branch: overnight/2026-11-12/r1-05-i316-cpu-bundle-budgets

PR: #327 (based on the phase F branch, `r1-04-i314`, not main).

- Section model is lazy: `loadSectionModel()` (`sections/load-model.ts`, exported from the package) is a cached dynamic import. `SectionTracker(model | null, tuning)` idles until `setModel(model)`. `createAnalysers()` and the app's `createAudioAnalysis()` start the load and expose `sectionModelReady: Promise<void>`. `analyze()` is now async.
